_what: covex-v6-state (rung 2): which of the rung's four additions moves decisions
_register: DRY cells, no GPU and no engine. That is a HARD LIMIT on two of the four additions and is the first thing to read below, not a footnote

digests._convention: sha256 over decision rows with arm_version removed, 16 hex

negative_control._claim: the rung with every addition off collapses to covex-v6-rules byte-identically

state_priced_costs.evidence: -noprice returns to the rung below's digest exactly, and it is the ONLY ablation that does. Turning this one switch off restores covex-v6-rules; turning either other one off leaves the full rung's digest unchanged
state_priced_costs.why_only_at_16_devices: it changes what a warm COSTS against the budget, so it can only matter once the budget is the binding constraint. At 8 devices covex-v6-state is byte-identical to covex-v6-rules (69874e94d2ddee85 both), which is the same fact seen from the other side and not a second result
state_priced_costs.effect: 17,050 decision rows fall to 15,734, a 7.7 percent reduction

per_type_host_retention.rule2_class: UNEXERCISED, and UNEXERCISABLE in this cell
per_type_host_retention.why: it acts by sending kv_transfer_params (max_offload_tokens = 0 for alert and single-shot) to vLLM. A dry cell has NO ENGINE, so the controls are emitted and nothing receives them. The null here is a property of the harness and carries no information about the mechanism

belief_from_telemetry.rule2_class: UNEXERCISED, and UNEXERCISABLE in this cell
belief_from_telemetry.why: the corrector is driven by the engine's own cached_tokens. A dry cell produces none, so it cannot fire. coordinator.py says this of itself in the comment on the belief-correction gate: a dry byte-identity screen proves the correction harmless and proves NOTHING about this read

plan_state.rule2_class: FIRED AND DID NOT HELP, with the reason named
plan_state.why: 44,300 state decisions, KEEP on every one. plan_state's own argmax prefers a non-KEEP candidate on 44,299 of them and D151's margin rule overrides it back on every one. Max predicted gain 0.151 against MARGIN_CF 0.16456, arithmetic ceiling 0.250, so a near miss and not a cap

harm_warm.reading: ALL 65 decisions that coincided with a real rebuild had nothing queued behind the warm, so harm_warm was a true zero on every one and HOLD_BACK's gain was 0 throughout. THIS CELL SAYS NOTHING ABOUT WHETHER THE COMPUTATION WORKS. The 8-device cell is the only evidence that it does: 527 of 2,035 decisions priced, mean over the priced set 0.1039, max 0.120, capped 0
harm_warm.superseded_claim: an earlier 16-device run showed 897 HOLD_BACK choices all clearing the margin. Those were scored for sessions NOBODY WAS WARMING, so they weighed a rebuild that was never going to happen, and nothing was emitted for any of them. UNEXPRESSIBLE under Rule 2, not a finding

verdict: covex-v6-state differs from covex-v6-rules at 16 devices through STATE-BASED PRICING ALONE. plan_state decides and never deviates. The other two additions cannot be exercised without an engine, so the dry evidence for this rung is exhausted and only a live cell can test them
